The course is in an ideal format for us to learn Arabic, a language which is relatively more difficult to learn. The homework each week, which neither too difficult nor does it take long, is very useful in helping us practice our writing. Also, right after we learn the topics, we always do speaking drills where Ahmet hoca makes everyone participate in order. I find these drills to be very useful by making us use and repeat the topics which we’ve just learned. The only real challenge is to learn the alphabet and reading in 1-2 weeks but this was still easier than what I anticipated.
